column1: # S905X3 TV boxes the TV box image can start on, and the device-tree file that describes each to Linux
# build-image.sh --board KEY writes the file's name into the card's uEnv.txt; it can be changed there later
# from any computer (tvbox/README.md, "If something does not work"). The installer number is the box's number
# in the community installer's list (armbian-install, the same file's first column), which an installer card
# (build-image.sh --installer) answers it with when it copies itself onto the box's own memory.
